messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: auth_failure_rate > 1200/min for service=svc-telemetry in us-west-2. Trigger=auth-401-spike, severity=high. Pager: @lisa (oncall), @eli (sec)
eli (sec): On it. Any initial context? Is this new key/service or traffic pattern change?
lisa (oncall): noticed around 14:02 UTC. lots of 401s from svc-telemetry -> edges, but also some 200s with truncated tokens in logs. quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM auth_logs WHERE service='svc-telemetry' AND status=401 AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'` -> 1.2k
maria (platform): I'm seeing three external IPs hitting an old telemetry ingestion endpoint we deprecated last month. Could be replay against archived key.
jon (sre): uploading small sample to debug bucket, redacted but shows header leak. sample log: ```
[2025-03-09T14:03:11Z] svc-telemetry recv: POST /ingest HTTP/1.1
Host: ingest.redwood.example
X-Auth-Token: sV-abc123..[REDACTED]..xyz
payload_size=512
```
eli (sec): that header looks truncated but enough to reconstruct token family. Opsbot, correlation?
opsbot: automated-correlation: matched 1,142 failed auth attempts from 3 IPs (54.201.12.34, 34.210.45.66, 3.92.100.8) over 7 minutes. Found 18 distinct token prefixes reused. Possible leaked logs or client misconfig.
lisa (oncall): immediate plan: 1) block those IPs at edge. 2) rotate svc-telemetry service key. 3) add temporary WAF rule to block malformed header patterns. 4) brief legal + support for customer impact. Can someone take rotation?
maria (platform): I can do rotation, but need confirmation: rotate service account keys -> yes? This will cause short reconnects for dedicated private deployments pinned to that key. Inform support.
eli (sec): rotate now. Do not rotate anything else yet. Capture ephemeral copies for forensics (no overwrite). Sam (legal), can you standby for any PII leak assessment?
sam (legal): standby. If there's customer data in logs, we may need to notify depending on scope. Keep me posted.
jon (sre): running command: ```
redwoodctl iam keys rotate --service svc-telemetry --force --preserve-old=48h
```
jon (sre): rotation command executed at 14:07 UTC. New key issued, old key kept for 48h for in-flight sessions.
ryan (support): opening support incident template, will prepare banner copy in case customers see errors. Ping me exact impact window.
lisa (oncall): Edge block applied (cloudfront WAF rule id wf-8734) at 14:08 UTC -> dropped traffic from listed IPs. Monitoring now.
opsbot: mitigation update: error rate for svc-telemetry dropped from 1200/min to 45/min in 3 minutes after WAF and block. Suspicious replay attempts continue at low volume from rotating IPs.
eli (sec): good. Next: search S3 and staging for log exports containing token-like strings. Use the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-leak-triage. Maria, can you run the S3 scan? Script snippet: ```
python tools/find_tokens.py --prefix="logs/" --regex="sV-[A-Za-z0-9-_]{8,}" --bucket redwood-archive
```
maria (platform): started scan at 14:12 UTC. estimate 10m. Will report matches.
jon (sre): rolling out temporary client-side header validation in ingress to reject malformed tokens (non-base64 sections) at 14:15 UTC. Minimal perf hit.
opsbot: s3-scan summary (prelim): 4 objects with token-like strings in staging logs (redwood-archive/logs/2025/02/28/*). All are from internal debugging snapshots — one contained partial token string matching prefix seen in replay. Marked for retention for forensics.
eli (sec): escalate to Pager-2 if we see >5k attempts or confirmed customer token exposure. For now, treat as limited leak of internal debug logs. Good job on rotation.
ryan (support): crafting customer-facing language: "We mitigated a suspected telemetry header leak; some internal debug logs contained truncated tokens that could enable replay; we've rotated affected keys and blocked malicious IPs. No active customer compromise detected. We'll follow up if further evidence emerges." Will hold until legal reviews.
sam (legal): wording ok, remove speculative phrasing, add timeline and mitigation bullets.
lisa (oncall): handing to eli for post-incident follow-up and forensic timeline. I'll standby for 30m then return to normal ops. @eli please take lead. :white_check_mark:
eli (sec): taking over. I'll coordinate a deeper scan, replay hazard assessment, and recommend longer-term controls: disable debug log shipping to archive, require token redaction in telemetry, and rotate any other keys discovered in same timeframe.
opsbot: final telemetry: auth failure rate at 14:25 UTC stable at baseline. Continuing passive monitoring.
eli (sec): thanks team. If no further anomalies in 30m, I'll close the pager and file an incident report. tagging runbook link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-leak-triage :memo:
lisa (oncall): ack. :thumbsup:
notes: incident triage, IP blocks, service key rotation, S3 log scan, legal/support notification
